question: In which of the following years was the Vijayanagar empire founded?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1336**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** The Vijayanagar empire was founded in 1336**__.

 __
 
• The Vijayanagara kingdom was founded by **Harihara and Bukka of the Sangama dynasty.**
 
• The Vijayanagara Empire also called the Karnata Kingdom was based in the Deccan Plateau region in South India.
 
• **Harihara and Bukka made Hampi the capital city.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• The Vijayanagar kingdom was one of the important kingdoms in medieval Indian history.
 
• Krishnadeva Raya of the Tuluva dynasty was the most famous king of the Vijayanagar Empire.
 
• **The Vijayanagara Empire was ruled by 4 dynasties:**
 
 
• Sangama Dynasty
 
• Saluva Dynasty
 
• Tuluva Dynasty
 
• Aravidu Dynasty
 
 
 
• Bukka Raya defeated almost all the southern kingdoms and extended his empire till the present day Rameshwaram.
